CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly identified and paired with an explicit origin/organization status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linked to any identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content assignments (color-to-coordinate mappings) identify content and an attribute.

D.rationale: Origins/kinds are separately recorded, distinguishing identification from record/status for the same content referents.

O.rationale: Entries include explicit organization/presentation markers (origin kinds, candidate vs current) describing how content is represented/emerges.
